comments.note: DatabaseBootstrapResult is defined as a sealed record inside IDatabaseBootstrapper.cs. This co-location is pragmatic for a single-consumer result type. If result types proliferate in later WPs, consider a dedicated Results/ folder in Core.

IDbConnectionFactory returns IDbConnection (System.Data) rather than a MySqlConnector-specific type. This keeps Core free of external NuGet dependencies and follows the abstraction convention, but callers in Infrastructure that need MySqlConnector-specific APIs (e.g. async methods on MySqlConnection) will need to cast. Document this pattern when implementing MySqlConnectionFactory in WP-007.

comments.note: IPasswordHasher.cs: Removed 'using a fixed salt' from the class-level <summary>. Interface contracts should be implementation-neutral — prescribing a salt strategy at the abstraction layer would create misleading coupling between the interface and a specific hashing algorithm. The implementation is free to document its own salt mechanism.

IDatabaseConnectionStore.cs: Replaced <see cref="DatabaseOptions.ActiveConnectionId"/> with plain prose in the SetActiveAsync docstring. Interface documentation must not reference concrete implementation types — doing so leaks implementation details through the abstraction boundary and creates a hidden coupling between the interface contract and the persistence model.

[documentation-forward] IPasswordHasher.Hash and Verify should have their param XML docs completed: Hash is missing <param name="password"> and its <returns> could state 'A hash string suitable for storage and subsequent Verify calls'; Verify is missing <param name="password"> and <param name="hash"> docs.

[documentation-forward] ShellStateChangedEventArgs constructor has no XML <param> docs. Low priority — params are self-documenting — but adding them would make the class consistent with the rest of the file.

DatabaseBootstrapResult is co-located in IDatabaseBootstrapper.cs. Correct and pragmatic for now. If result/DTO types proliferate in later WPs, consider a dedicated Results/ folder under Core/Abstractions/.
